gate_definitions.name: Rule written down before any outcome was computed
gate_definitions.detail: The rule file is committed and its SHA-256 is published with the results.

gate_definitions.name: Walk-forward: no look-ahead information
gate_definitions.detail: Ratings and form use only games with week < W.

gate_definitions.name: Bootstrap 95% CI for mean edge has a lower bound above 0
Beats the break-even vig of a real sportsbook
gate_definitions.detail: Needs book prices. BLOCKED: no official odds and no licensed feed.

gate_definitions.name: No single week supplies more than 40% of the total edge
Holds up in a second season
gate_definitions.detail: BLOCKED: only 2026 results are transcribed and verified in this repo.

gate_definitions.name: Correlation below 0.70 with every other passing rule
gate_definitions.detail: Parlay diversification check. Evaluated once two rules pass.

gate_definitions.name: p-value survives Benjamini-Hochberg at FDR 0.10
gate_definitions.detail: Multiple-testing correction across all graded rules.

gate_definitions.name: Beats a random-bet null (permutation p <= 0.05)
gate_definitions.detail: 10,000 same-size random draws from the same weeks. This is the luck test.

gate_definitions.name: Selector is independent of the number the outcome is measured against
gate_definitions.detail: Catches self-referential rules such as 'bet my biggest edge'.

window.note: Weeks 4-9 of 2026; weeks 1-3 are used only to train the ratings and the form measures.

rules.name: Rest edge
rules.text: Bet the side with at least 3 more days of rest than its opponent. Rest = days since that club's previous game.

rules.name: Home team off a bye
rules.text: Bet the home side when it has had 13+ days since its last game and the visitor has not.

rules.name: Division dog
rules.text: In division games, bet the club with the worse net points per game (points for minus points against, from completed games only).

parlay.name: Two-leg correlated parlay
parlay.text: Combine the two least-correlated graded rules. Legs are only worth combining if their outcomes are genuinely independent; the measured correlation decides that, not intuition.

rewards.scoring: 3 points per graded win against my line; +25 for a rule that passes every gate.
